chunks: Satan has got the better of them. and made them forget to remember God. Indeed they belong to Satan's faction. Will not Satan's faction perish?
ai.seo_question: Who are the Party of Satan and why are they considered the losers?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the spiritual consequence of neglecting *Dhikr* (remembrance of God), identifying the 'Party of Satan' (*Hizb al-Shaytan*) as those whose hearts are dominated by worldly desires due to this forgetfulness. It serves as a counterpoint to the 'Party of God' (*Hizb Allah*), emphasizing that true success lies in maintaining conscious awareness of the Divine against the subtle whispers of Satan.
